title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Brand document reports with report themes
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 introduces branded document reports with composable layout themes. Administrators can apply consistent styling to PDF outputs at global, company, report, or layout levels using Word themes saved as .dotx templates.
key_points: New composable layouts feature allows applying report themes to Word layouts for consistent visual styling
Themes can be configured at multiple levels: globally, per company, per report, or per layout
Themes must be created as .dotx Word template files and approved before assignment to reports
Layout Subtype property distinguishes between Default, Body, HeaderFooter, and Theme layouts for composite layout support
Themes and headers/footers can only be applied to Word layouts with Body subtype, not RDLC layouts

quotes.text: With the new composable layouts feature, you can apply a report theme on layouts to get consistent look and feel on the PDF output.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core capability of applying themes to achieve visual consistency across business documents

quotes.text: It is possible to set defaults on a global level, per company, per report, or per layout, giving the administrator full flexibility of theming.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the flexibility administrators have in controlling theme application across the organization

quotes.text: Only approved themes and header/footer parts can be assigned.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows that themes must go through an approval process before they can be used in reports
